figures.caption: Figure 2: Peak GPU memory consumption per method and architecture. Quantized methods (QLoRA, QDoRA) reduce memory by up to 86.9% for Base and 81.9% for Large relative to Full FT. Memory values for generative models (Tucano-1B, Sabiá-7B) are included for cross-architecture comparison; results for those models are discussed in Section 5.5. The dashed red line marks the 20 GB GPU limit of the hardware used.

Figure 1: F1 score for all PEFT methods across all configurations (learning rate × epochs × architecture). A bold border remarks the single best overall result per column; gray dashed borders show the best PEFT method per column. When both criteria coincide (i.e., a PEFT method is also the best overall), they are shown together. Values in parentheses indicate training collapse of full fine-tuning (Full FT) on BERTimbau-Large under high learning rate (lr=2× 10−4), observed across both 2 and 3 epoch settings.
